class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:3;position:relative;"></div><div class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:1;position:relative;"><img src="img240839349_0.jpg" alt="img240839349_0.jpg" style="transform:translate(0px, 0px) rotate(0.0deg);z-index:257952768;overflow:hidden;top:0.9583in;left:6.6563in;width:1.8646in;position:absolute;height:0.1042in;"></div><div style="padding-top:0.69in;z-index:2;min-height:0.93in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 14.1</font></p><p style="margin-left:360pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div><div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#0f4761;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:16pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CIFC Direct Lending Evergreen Fund Code of Ethics</font></h2><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Purpose of the Code of Ethics</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company has adopted this 1940 Act Code of Ethics to set forth guidelines and procedures that promote ethical practices and conduct by all of the Company&#x2019;s Access Persons, as defined below, and to ensure compliance with the Federal Securities Laws. To the extent that any such individual is subject to compliance with the separately maintained Code of Ethics of the Adviser, Administrator or underwriter, as applicable, whose Codes of Ethics comply with Rule 17j-1, compliance by such individuals with the provisions of the Code of Ethics of the applicable service provider (the Adviser, Administrator or underwriter) shall constitute compliance with this 1940 Act Code of Ethics. The 1940 Act Code of Ethics is based on the principle that each Access Person of the Company will conduct such activities in accordance with the following principles:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">to be dutiful in placing the interests of the Company&#x2019;s shareholders first and before their own;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">all personal securities transactions must be conducted consistently with this 1940 Act Code of Ethics and in such a manner as to avoid any actual or potential conflict of interest or any abuse of an individual's position of the Company and responsibility; and</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">adhere to the fundamental standard that Access Persons shall not take inappropriate advantage of their position.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any violation of this 1940 Act Code of Ethics must be reported promptly to the Company CCO. Failure to do so will be deemed a violation of the 1940 Act Code of Ethics.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Legal Requirement</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pursuant to Rule 17j-1(b) of the 1940 Act, it is unlawful for any Access Person to:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">employ any device, scheme or artifice to defraud the Company;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">make any untrue statement of a material fact to the Company or fail to state a material fact necessary in order to make the statements made to the Company, in light of the circumstances under which they were made, not misleading;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">engage in any act, practice, or course of business which operates or would operate as a fraud or deceit upon the Company; or</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">engage in any manipulative practice with respect to the Company, in connection with the purchase or sale (directly or indirectly) by such Access Person of a security &#34;held or to be acquired&#34; by the Company.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Definitions </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">- All definitions shall have the same meaning as explained in Rule 17j-1 or Section 2(a) of the 1940 Act and are summarized below.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Access Person</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x2013; Any officers, Directors, general partner or employee of the Company or of the Adviser (or of any entity in a control relationship to the Company or Adviser) who, in connection with his/her regular functions or duties, makes, participates in, or obtains information regarding the purchase or sale of Covered Securities by the Company, or whose functions relate to the making of any recommendations with respect to such purchases or sales.</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1</font></p></div></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">
  <div class="page" style="flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;display:flex;min-height:11in;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:6;position:relative;"></div><div class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:4;position:relative;"></div><div class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:3;position:relative;"></div><div class="absolute-block-container" style="margin-left:-0.67in;z-index:1;position:relative;"><img src="img240839349_0.jpg" alt="img240839349_0.jpg" style="transform:translate(0px, 0px) rotate(0.0deg);z-index:262147072;overflow:hidden;top:0.6979in;left:6.625in;width:1.8646in;position:absolute;height:0.1042in;"><img src="img240839349_1.jpg" alt="img240839349_1.jpg" style="transform:translate(0px, 0px) rotate(0.0deg);z-index:253758464;overflow:hidden;top:10.6042in;left:0.0104in;width:8.4792in;position:absolute;height:0.3958in;"></div><div style="padding-top:0.69in;z-index:2;min-height:0.93in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div><div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Automatic Investment Plan</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> &#x2013; A program in which regular periodic purchases (or withdrawals) are made automatically in (or from) investment accounts in accordance with a predetermined schedule and allocation. An Automatic Investment Plan includes a dividend reinvestment plan.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Beneficial Ownership</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> &#x2013; in general and subject to the specific provisions of Rule 16a-1(a)(2) under the Exchange Act having or sharing, directly or indirectly, through any contract arrangement, understanding, relationship, or otherwise, a direct or indirect &#x201c;pecuniary interest&#x201d; in the security.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Connected Persons</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> &#x2013; Adult children or parents living at home, and any relative, person or entity for whom the Access Person directs the investments or securities trading unless otherwise specified.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Control</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - shall have the same meaning as that set forth in Section 2(a)(9) of the Exchange Act.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Covered Security</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> &#x2013; shall be any security except that it does not include:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Direct obligations of the Government of the United States;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Bankers&#x2019; acceptances, bank certificates of deposit, commercial paper and high-quality short-term debt instruments, including repurchase agreements; and</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Shares issued by open-end funds (excluding open-end exchange traded funds).</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exchange Traded Fund (&#x201c;ETF&#x201d;)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - an open-end registered investment company that is not a unit investment trust, and that operates pursuant to an order from the SEC exempting it from certain provisions of the 1940 Act permitting it to issue securities that trade on the secondary market. Examples of open-end exchange-traded funds include, but are not limited to: Select Sector SPDRS; iShares; PowerShares; etc.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Fund</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - an investment company registered under the 1940 Act.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Independent Directors</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - those directors of the Company that would not be deemed an &#x201c;interested person&#x201d; of the Company, as defined in Section 2(a)(19)(A) of the 1940 Act.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Initial Public Offering</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - an offering of securities registered under the Securities Act, the issuer of which, immediately before the registration, was not subject to the reporting requirements of Sections 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Act.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investment Personnel - </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">any employee of the Company or Adviser (or of any company in a control relationship to the Company or Adviser) who, in connection with his or her regular functions or duties, makes or participates in making recommendations regarding the purchase or sale of securities by the Company or any natural person who controls the Company or Adviser and who obtains information concerning recommendations made to the Company regarding the purchase or sale of securities by the Company.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Limited Offering</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - an offering that is exempt from registration pursuant to Section 4(2) or Section 4(6) or pursuant to Rule 504, Rule 505, or Rule 506 under the Securities Act.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Purchase or Sale of a Covered Security</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> - includes, among other things, the writing of an option to purchase or sell a Covered Security.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Security held or to be Acquired by the Company</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> means:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any Covered Security which, within the most recent fifteen (15) days:</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.45972222222222225in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:left;"><font class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div purchase by the Company; and</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.45972222222222225in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any option to purchase or sell, and any security convertible into or exchangeable for, a Covered Security.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Policies of the Company Regarding Personal Securities Transactions General</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">No Access Person of the Company shall engage in any act, practice or course of business that would violate the provisions of Rule 17j-1 as set forth above, or in connection with any personal investment activity, engage in conduct inconsistent with this 1940 Act Code of Ethics.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Specific Policies</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.0798611111111111in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.5313748293472216%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restrictions on personal securities transactions by Access Persons, other than Independent Directors and persons covered under an equivalent code of ethics of the Company&#x2019;s service provider.</font></div></div><p style="margin-left:23.75pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">No Access Person shall purchase or sell, directly or indirectly, any security in which he/she has, or by reason of such transaction acquires, any direct or indirect beneficial ownership and which he/she knows or should have known at the time of such purchase or sale:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.8298611111111112in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.949779436715304%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">is being considered for purchase or sale by the Company; or </font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.8298611111111112in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.949779436715304%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">is being purchased or sold by the Company. </font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.07916666666666666in;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pre-approval of Investments in IPOs and Limited Offerings.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investment Personnel must obtain approval from the Adviser (pursuant to the terms of the Adviser&#x2019;s Code of Ethics) before directly or indirectly acquiring beneficial ownership in any Covered Securities in an Initial Public Offering or in a private placement or other Limited Offering.</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.0798611111111111in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.5313748293472216%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">2.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restrictions on personal securities transactions by Independent Directors.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company recognizes that an Independent Director does not have on-going, day-to-day involvement with the operations of the Company. In addition, it has been the practice of the Company to give information about securities purchased or sold by the Company or considered for purchase or sale by the Company to Independent Directors in materials circulated more than 15 days after such securities are purchased or sold by the Company or are considered for purchase or sale by the Company. Accordingly, the Company believes that less stringent controls are appropriate for Independent Directors, as follows:</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Independent Directors need not make an initial or annual holdings report but shall submit the same quarterly report as required under the Reporting Requirements below, but only for a transaction in a Covered Security where he or she knew or, in the ordinary course of fulfilling his or her official duties as an Independent Director, should have known, that during the 15-day period immediately preceding the date of the transaction such Covered Security is or was purchased or sold, or considered for purchase for sale, by the Company.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reporting Requirements</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company CCO or designee shall monitor all personal trading activity of all Access Persons as deemed appropriate and covered by this 1940 Act Code of Ethics. An Access Person of the Company who is also an Access Person of a Service Provider may submit such reporting requirements via the forms prescribed by any such separate code of ethics (and not directly to the Company CCO) provided that the associated forms comply with the requirements of Rule 17j-1(d)(1) of the 1940 Act.</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p></div></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">
  <div class="page" style="flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;display:flex;min-height:11in;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="padding-top:0.69in;z-index:2;min-height:0.93in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div><div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Initial/Ongoing Disclosure of Personal Brokerage Accounts</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">. Within ten (10) days of the commencement of employment or at the commencement of a relationship with the Company, all Access Persons, except Independent Directors, are required to submit to the Company CCO a report stating the names and account numbers of all of their personal brokerage accounts, brokerage accounts of any Connected Person, and any brokerage accounts which they control or in which they or a Connected Person has Beneficial Ownership. Such report must contain the date on which it is submitted and the information in the report must be current as of a date no more than forty-five (45) days prior to that date. In addition, if a new brokerage account is opened during the course of the year, the Company CCO must be notified immediately. The information required above must be provided to the Company CCO on an annual basis. Disclosure of an account shall cover, at a minimum, all accounts at a broker-dealer, bank or other institution opened during the quarter and provide the following information:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">the name of the broker, dealer or bank with whom the Access Person has established the account;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">the date the account was established;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">the date that the report is submitted by the Access Person.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Each of these accounts is required to furnish duplicate confirmations and statements to the Company CCO.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CCO Holdings Report.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> Within ten (10) days of becoming an Access Person (and with information that is current as of a date no more than forty-five (45) days prior to the date that the person becomes an Access Person), each Access Person, except Independent Directors, must submit (i) a holdings report that must contain, at a minimum, the title and type of security, and as applicable, the exchange ticker symbol or CUSIP number, number of shares, and principal amount of each Covered Security in which the Access Person has any direct or indirect Beneficial Ownership and (ii) the name of any broker, dealer or bank with whom the Access Person maintained an account in which any securities were held for the Access Person&#x2019;s direct or indirect benefit as of the date they became an Access Person. This report must state the date on which it is submitted.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Quarterly Transaction Reports.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> All Access Persons, except Independent Directors, shall report to the Company CCO or designee the following information with respect to transactions in a Covered Security in which such person has, or by reason of such transaction acquires, any direct or indirect Beneficial Ownership in the Covered Security:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The date of the transaction, the title, and as applicable, the exchange ticker symbol or CUSIP number, interest rate and maturity date, number of shares, and the principal amount of each Covered Security;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:3.6606459593471223%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The nature of the transaction (i.e., purchase, sale or any other type of acquisition or disposition);</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The price of the Covered Security at which the transaction was effected;</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font transaction was effected; and</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:0.32986111111111116in;display:flex;margin-top:10pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.25in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The date the Access Person submits the report.</font></div></div><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reports pursuant to this section of this 1940 Act Code of Ethics shall be made no later than thirty (30) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which the transaction to which the report relates was effected and shall include a certification that the reporting person has reported all personal securities transactions required to be disclosed or reported pursuant to the requirements of this 1940 Code of Ethics. Confirmations and brokerage statements sent directly to the appropriate address noted above is an acceptable form of a quarterly transaction report.</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p></div></div></div>

Such certification shall be submitted to the Board of Directors at least annually.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Adopted:</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p></div></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">
  <div class="page" style="flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;display:flex;min-height:11in;"><div class="fixed-width-container" src="img240839349_0.jpg" alt="img240839349_0.jpg" style="transform:translate(0px, 0px) style="transform:translate(0px, 0px) rotate(0.0deg);z-index:253758464;overflow:hidden;top:10.6042in;left:0.0104in;width:8.4792in;position:absolute;height:0.3958in;"></div><div style="padding-top:0.69in;z-index:2;min-height:0.93in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;" id="x__sarbanes_oxley_code_of_ethics_for_chi"><font style="color:#0f4761;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:16pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics for Chief Executive and Senior Financial Officers</font></h2><p style="margin-left:18pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CIFC Direct Lending Evergreen Fund (the &#x201c;Company&#x201d;) is committed to conducting business in accordance with applicable laws, rules and regulations and the highest standards of business ethics, and to fully and accurately disclose financial information in compliance with applicable law. This Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics, applicable to the Company&#x2019;s Principal Executive Officer, Principal Financial Officer (or persons performing similar functions) (together, &#x201c;Senior Officers&#x201d;), sets forth specific policies to guide such individuals in the performance of their duties.</font></p><p style="margin-left:18pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">As a Senior Officer, you must comply with applicable law. You also have a responsibility to conduct yourself in an honest and ethical manner; and you have leadership responsibilities that include creating a culture of high ethical standards and commitment to compliance, maintaining a work environment that encourages employees to raise concerns, and promptly addressing employee compliance concerns.</font></p><p style="margin-left:18pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Code of Ethics of the Company pursuant to Rule 17j-1(c) under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#x201c;1940 Act&#x201d;) (the &#x201c;1940 Act Code of Ethics&#x201d;), which this Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics is intended to supplement, sets forth the fundamental principles and key policies and procedures that govern the conduct of persons acting on behalf of registered investment companies. All Covered Officers will be held accountable for adherence to this Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics. Each Covered Officer must, upon the Company&#x2019;s adoption of this Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics (or thereafter as applicable, upon becoming a Covered Officer), affirm in writing to the Board that he/she has received, read, and understands this Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics by signing the Acknowledgement Form attached hereto as Exhibit A. Thereafter, each Covered Officer, on an annual basis, must affirm to the Board that he/she has complied with the requirements of this Sarbanes-Oxley Code of Ethics.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#0f4761;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Compliance with Laws, Rules and Regulations</font></p><p style="margin-left:18pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">You are required to comply with the laws, rules and regulations that govern the conduct of our business and to report any suspected violations in accordance with the section below entitled &#x201c;Violations&#x201d;.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#0f4761;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Conflicts of Interest</font></p><p style="margin-left:18pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Senior Officers are expected to dedicate their best efforts to advancing the Company&#x2019;s interests and to use objective and unbiased standards when making decisions that affect the Company, keeping in mind that you are subject to inherent conflicts of interest because certain officers are also officers of </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CIFC Private Credit Management, LLC </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(the &#x201c;Adviser&#x201d;) as well as the Company. Your obligation to conduct the Company&#x2019;s business in an honest and ethical manner includes the ethical handling of actual or apparent conflicts of interest between personal and business relationships. A conflict of interest for the purpose of this 1940 Act Code of Ethics occurs when your private interests interfere in any way, or even appear to interfere, with the interests of the Company. The 1940 Act Code of Ethics, the Adviser&#x2019;s and the Company&#x2019;s allocation procedures and the other policies of the Company are designed to ensure the ethical handling of such conflicts. As a result, it is incumbent on you to be familiar with the 1940 Act Code of Ethics, the Adviser&#x2019;s and Company&#x2019;s allocations procedures and other rules and regulations under the 1940 Act as well as the policies of the Company. When making any investment, accepting any position or benefits, participating in any transaction or business arrangement, or otherwise acting in a manner that creates or appears to create a conflict of interest where you are receiving a personal benefit, you should act in accordance with the letter and the spirit of the 1940 Act Code of Ethics and/or the Company&#x2019;s or the Adviser&#x2019;s other applicable policies and procedures. If you are in doubt as to the</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p></div></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">

Company to make full, fair, accurate, timely and understandable disclosure in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations in all reports and documents that the Company files with, or submits to, the Securities and Exchange Commission (&#x201c;SEC&#x201d;) and in all other public communications made by the Company. As a Senior Officer, you are required to promote compliance with this policy by all employees and to abide by the Company&#x2019;s standards, policies and procedures designed to promote compliance with this 1940 Act Code of Ethics.</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.67in;width:7.16in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.67in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.33in;min-height:0.46in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;">&#160;</p></div></div></div>

prescribed by law.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font A</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font
